name: School
definition: An individual California public school site, identified by its 14-digit CDS code. School-level facts (enrollment, meal eligibility, SAT performance, classification, address, administrators, location) are recorded per school.
scope: School-site-level analysis across the schools, frpm and satscores tables.

name: District
definition: A school district or other local educational agency (unified, elementary, high school, county office of education, ROC/P, state special school district) that administers one or more schools.
scope: District-level grouping, filtering and aggregation; also the reporting level of district-aggregate SAT rows.

name: County
definition: The California county in which a school or district is located; used as a geographic grouping and filter dimension.
scope: Geographic filtering and grouping of schools.

name: City
definition: The city or community in which a school is located, as recorded on the school's physical address.
scope: Geographic filtering and grouping of schools at city granularity.

name: CDS Code
definition: The California Department of Education County-District-School (CDS) code: a 14-digit identifier composed of a 2-digit county code, a 5-digit district code and a 7-digit school code. The school portion 0000000 denotes a district/agency-level record rather than a school site.
scope: Identity and linkage of schools and districts across schools, frpm and satscores.

name: School Address
definition: The postal address of a school, available in a physical-address form and a mailing-address form. A complete communication address consists of street, city, state and zip code.
scope: Address retrieval and address-based filtering for schools.

name: Grade Span Offered
definition: The range of grade levels a school is authorised to offer (for example K-8, 9-12, K-12), expressed in CDE grade-span notation where K denotes kindergarten, P denotes preschool and numbers denote grade levels.
scope: Grade-span filtering, e.g. schools offering a Kindergarten to 8th grade span.

name: Grade Span Served
definition: The range of grade levels a school actually serves, which may be narrower than the grade span offered when the school does not operate every authorised grade.
scope: Distinguishing actually-served grades from authorised grade range.

name: FRPM Low/High Grade Range
definition: The lowest and highest grade levels reported for a school in the free/reduced-price-meal file, expressed as separate low-grade and high-grade values using the same notation as the grade span (K, P, Adult, or a numeric grade).
scope: Grade-range filtering on the free/reduced-price-meal population.

name: Enrollment (K-12)
definition: Count of students enrolled in kindergarten through grade 12 at a school, reported in the free/reduced-price-meal file. The workload treats wording such as 'grades 1 through 12' and 'K-12' enrollment as this measure.
scope: Enrollment magnitude, rankings and denominators for K-12 meal-eligibility rates.

name: Enrollment (Ages 5-17)
definition: Count of enrolled students aged 5 to 17 at a school, reported in the free/reduced-price-meal file on an age basis rather than a grade basis.
scope: Enrollment magnitude on an age basis; required when a question is phrased by student age (e.g. 'students from the ages of 5 to 17').

name: Free Meal Count (K-12)
definition: Count of K-12 students eligible for free meals at a school, excluding students eligible only for reduced-price meals.
scope: Free-meal population counts and the numerator of the eligible free rate.

name: Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)
definition: Count of students aged 5 to 17 eligible for free meals at a school, excluding students eligible only for reduced-price meals.
scope: Free-meal population counts when the question is phrased by student age.

name: FRPM Count (K-12)
definition: Count of K-12 students eligible for free and/or reduced-price meals at a school; it includes reduced-price-eligible students that the free-meal count excludes, so the two counts differ for most schools.
scope: Combined free-or-reduced-price meal population counts and the numerator of the eligible FRPM rate.
aliases: free and reduced price meal count

name: Eligible Free Rate (K-12)
definition: The share of a school's K-12 enrolment that is eligible for free meals, computed as the free meal count divided by K-12 enrolment. Stored as a 0-1 fraction in the source table.
scope: Meal-eligibility intensity comparisons and rankings across schools.

name: Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)
definition: The share of a school's K-12 enrolment that is eligible for free or reduced-price meals, computed as the FRPM count divided by K-12 enrolment. Stored as a 0-1 fraction in the source table.
scope: Combined meal-eligibility intensity comparisons across schools.

name: SAT Average Score
definition: Average SAT section score reported for a school or district, available separately for reading, mathematics and writing. Reported only at the reporting level indicated on the same record.
scope: SAT performance comparison; the section (reading, math or writing) must be selected explicitly.

name: SAT Number of Test Takers
definition: Number of students who took the SAT at the reporting level of a record; zero for 218 records, for which no average scores are reported.
scope: SAT participation volume and the denominator of the excellence rate.

name: SAT NumGE1500
definition: Number of SAT test takers at the reporting level whose total score was 1500 or above; the numerator of the excellence rate.
scope: High-achievement SAT volume and the numerator of the excellence rate.

name: Excellence Rate
definition: The share of a school's or district's SAT test takers who scored 1500 or above, computed as NumGE1500 divided by NumTstTakr. It is not stored as a column and must be computed from the two SAT count columns.
scope: SAT high-achievement ranking and comparison; requires records with a non-zero test-taker count.

name: School Type (SOC)
definition: The CDE School Operation Category classifying what kind of public school a site is (for example Elementary Schools, Intermediate/Middle Schools, High Schools, K-12 Schools). It classifies school sites only and contains no district-type or 'Unified Schools' value.
scope: Selecting schools by type of school site.

name: District Type (DOC)
definition: The CDE District Operation Category classifying the administrative type of a district or agency (Unified School District, Elementary School District, High School District, County Office of Education, ROC/P, State Special Schools and others).
scope: Selecting schools by the administrative type of the district that operates them; also the level of district-aggregate records.

name: Educational Option Type (EdOpsCode)
definition: The CDE Educational Options code describing a school's educational operating model, such as Traditional, Continuation School, Community Day School, Special Education School, Alternative School of Choice, Juvenile Court School or State Special School.
scope: Selecting schools by educational operating model.

name: Virtual School Status
definition: Indicates the extent to which a school delivers instruction virtually: not virtual, exclusively (fully) virtual, partially virtual, or not reported.
scope: Identifying virtual and exclusively virtual schools.

name: Magnet Program
definition: Indicates whether a school offers a magnet program (a specialised curriculum programme open beyond the school's normal attendance area).
scope: Identifying schools that offer a magnet program.

name: Charter School
definition: Indicates whether a school operates as a charter school, together with its charter number and charter funding type where applicable.
scope: Selecting or excluding charter schools.

name: NSLP Provision Status
definition: The National School Lunch Program meal-provision category under which a school operates, such as Provision 1, Provision 2, Provision 3, CEP (Community Eligibility Provision) or Multiple Provision Types.
scope: Selecting schools by meal-provision arrangement.

name: School Open Date
definition: The date on which a school opened, as recorded in the schools table. A large share of records carry a single default date instead of a real opening date.
scope: Filtering or counting schools by opening period.

name: School Closed Date
definition: The date on which a school closed, populated only for schools that are no longer operating.
scope: Filtering schools by closure period and distinguishing operating from non-operating schools.

name: School Status Type
definition: The operating status of a school record: Active, Closed, Merged or Pending. Closed and merged records are retained in the data and can be included or excluded by the analyst.
scope: Restricting analysis to currently operating schools or deliberately including historical records.

name: School Administrator
definition: A person recorded as an administrator of a school, stored in up to three equally-weighted administrator slots each holding a first name, last name and e-mail address. A school may therefore have more than one administrator.
scope: Finding schools managed by a named person and retrieving administrator contact details.

name: Administrator E-mail Address
definition: The e-mail address recorded for an administrator in the same numbered administrator slot as that person's name. All recorded administrator e-mail addresses are syntactically valid addresses containing a local part, an '@' and a domain with a dot.
scope: Contact-detail retrieval for school administrators.

name: School Geographic Location
definition: The latitude and longitude of a school site. California longitudes are recorded as negative values, so westernmost locations have the largest absolute longitude.
scope: Geographic positioning, distance and coordinate-based selection of schools.

name: Academic Year
definition: The school year to which a set of reported facts applies. The free/reduced-price-meal file covers exactly one academic year.
scope: Time-scoping of enrolment and meal-eligibility facts.
